candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of opposition, resistance, or being against something across multiple languages.
This feature activates for tokens related to political, social, or systemic upheaval, transformation, and revolution across multiple languages.
Common German nominal suffixes and derivational morphemes used to form abstract nouns and adjectives.
This vector represents German definite articles, demonstrative pronouns, and relative pronouns, primarily in masculine and neuter dative and genitive cases.
This vector represents royalty, nobility, and monarchical rule.
This vector represents common prepositions across multiple Romance languages like French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian.
Past-tense action verbs indicating historical events or achievements.
This feature vector represents German auxiliary, modal, and copula verbs used to express tense, mood, and voice.
This vector activates on formal, restrictive, and structural terminology often found in political, legal, or administrative discourse.
This vector is related to political governance, institutional policy, and civic conflict.
